## MCP - LLM URL Extractor

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/llm-url-extractor

**Description:** Extracts structured information from a URL using LLM analysis.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["url"],
  "properties": {
    "url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL to fetch and extract information from (required)" },
    "extraction_schema": { "type": "object", "description": "JSON schema defining what to extract" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "User request context for personalized extraction" },
    "provider": { "type": "string", "description": "LLM provider: anthropic (default), openai" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "description": "Max output tokens (default: 2048)" },
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "User ID for tracing" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "Guild ID for tracing" }
  }
}
```

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": false,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["extracted_data", "source_url", "content_length"],
  "domain": "nlp"
}
```

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
